list.title: Notices and Announcements

roadRepair.title: Road Repair – Public E-Tender
roadRepair.description: Sealed tenders are invited from registered contractors for concreting the main road in Ward No. 4 of Mouje [Village Name]. The estimated project cost is ₹5,00,000.
roadRepair.additional: The tender submission deadline was 25 December 2025.

specialGramSabha.title: Notice Regarding a Special Gram Sabha Meeting
specialGramSabha.description: All villagers were informed that a Special Gram Sabha meeting was scheduled for 20 December 2025 at 10:00 AM at the Gram Panchayat office to discuss planning under the 15th Finance Commission.
specialGramSabha.additional: Villagers were requested to attend the meeting.

waterSupply.title: Notice Regarding Temporary Water Supply Suspension
waterSupply.description: Due to urgent repair work on the main water pipeline, the water supply across the village was scheduled to remain suspended on 18 December 2025.
waterSupply.additional: Residents were requested to store sufficient water in advance and cooperate during the repair work.

solarPump.title: Applications for the Solar Agricultural Pump Scheme
solarPump.description: Applications were invited from eligible farmers under the Kusum Solar Pump Scheme. Applicants in the open category were required to pay 10% of the applicable amount.
solarPump.additional: Interested farmers were requested to contact the Gram Panchayat office by 30 December 2025.

cleanlinessDrive.title: Village Cleanliness Drive
cleanlinessDrive.description: A community cleanliness and voluntary labour activity was organised at 7:00 AM on the occasion of the Swachhata Hi Seva campaign.
cleanlinessDrive.additional: Youth groups and self-help groups were invited to participate.

taxPayment.title: Appeal for House Tax and Water Tax Payment
taxPayment.description: Residents were encouraged to pay their house tax and water tax for the current financial year before 31 March 2026. A 5% tax concession was announced for eligible payments made within the specified period.
taxPayment.additional: Tax payments were accepted online or in cash at the Gram Panchayat office.

information.title: Stay Connected with the Gram Panchayat
information.description: Keep checking official announcements for information about public services and village development.
information.message: For clarification about any notice, tender or announcement, contact the Gram Panchayat office during working hours.
information.note: The notices displayed here include historical announcements. Please contact the Gram Panchayat office to confirm current schemes, deadlines and updated information.
